lines.t: Yeah—sun’s settin’ low, hearts start to glow,
Peace of the seventh, let the truth overflow,
Shabbat Shalom, let the Lion’s voice roam,
Light the flame in your soul—it’s time to come home.
Word of the Father like thunder in the sky,
Calling out the nations who forgot how to cry,
Truth like lightning, mercy redefined,
He’s breakin’ every chain that was lockin’ up your mind.
Six days grindin’—now stop, breathe deep,
Enter His rest, let your soul find sleep,
From sunset to sunrise, from fear to the flame,
All honor, all glory, one holy Name!
Yahushua!
Shabbat Shalom—yeah, feel the sound rise!
Hands to the heavens, truth in our eyes,
Rock the revelation, crash through the stone,
We rise, we shine—Shabbat Shalom!
(Yeah—Shabbat Shalom!)
Prophets cry out from the edge of time,
Justice rolls down in rhythm and rhyme,
The Word is alive—no script, just fire,
King on the throne, lift your heart higher!
Callin’ all tribes, let the heartbeat blend,
Peace ain’t a dream—it’s a place where we mend,
Lay down the weapon, pick up the song,
Rest in the promise, where we all belong.
Shabbat Shalom—yeah, feel the sound rise!
Hands to the heavens, truth in our eyes,
Rock the revelation, crash through the stone,
We rise, we shine—Shabbat Shalom!
(Shabbat Shalom!)
Silence the noise, the world fades away,
Seventh day glow—eternal replay,
Truth like a river, peace like a drum,
He’s callin’ His children—here we come!
Shabbat vibes, no chains, no lies,
We walk in the light, with fire in our eyes!
From the dusk to the dawn, He’s makin’ us whole,
Echoes of heaven burn deep in the soul,
Lift your voice up, shout His Name strong,
Shabbat Shalom—it’s a freedom song!
Shabbat Shalom
Shabbat Shalom
Shabbat Shalom
Shabbat Shalom
